messages:
maya: Quick sync to consolidate postmortem follow-ups for regional failover. Need owners + timelines for multi-region routing, backups, restore runbooks, and game-day tests. Please confirm owners.

sasha: I'll own multi-region routing. Plan: update traffic-manager policy, add metric gating and auto-fallback to compatible model variants. PR with config + tests by 2026-03-31. Need QA cluster and synthetic tests.

ryan: I'll own backups/snapshot audit. Running inventory today. Proposal: daily full snapshots for EU for 2 weeks for testing. ETA: 2 weeks. Blocker: temporary storage bump (finance).

alex: I'll own restore runbooks + verification checklists. Draft in Confluence (restore-runbooks). Propose restore game day in two weeks.

maya: Suggested game-day windows to avoid overlap: APAC week of 2026-04-10, EU week of 2026-04-17, NA week of 2026-04-24. @jean @lin confirm.

jean: EU window OK. I'll coordinate SRE rotation and reserve capacity, and add emergency contact list to runbook.

lin: NA window OK. Recommend a 'fail routing' dry-run to toggle routing policy and confirm fallback + KV cache repop. Sample simulate script provided.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 1 game-day invites will be sent 7 days before each window.

sasha: PR will include SLI for failover success rate (proposed 99%). Adding warmup stagger + autoscaler buffer to avoid cascades.

ryan: Finance approved temporary storage increase for EU snapshot testing for two weeks.

alex: Added restore command and post-restore traffic gating notes to runbook.

maya: I'll create an action tracker sheet (owner / due / status / notes) and ping weekly. Update by EOD Friday.

jean: I'll paste pre-game health-check results here before each game day.

lin: Observed pattern: regionally correlated CPU spikes during model warmups causing autoscaler jitter. Mitigation: stagger warmups and reserve buffer.

sasha: Adding warmup stagger and buffer to routing PR and autoscaler config.

ryan: Keep in mind restore tests must validate KV cache warmup and 95/99th latency under synthetic load.

alex: Game-day runbook draft ready in Confluence; ping me for edits.

maya: Summary actions: sasha - routing PR by 2026-03-31; ryan - backups audit and EU snapshot tests in 2 weeks; alex - finalize runbook + game-day; jean - pre-game checks; lin - warmup/scale changes. Reconvene next Tue 10:00 PT. :calendar:
